title: Cad Play Per Model Interactions
description: Wire interaction sessions and window engagement for every spatial play quad pane (shape, building, energy, structure-classic), not only shape.
summary: Spatial play now runs a full PlaySession (InteractionRepl + showEngagement) in every quad pane, with per-pane interactionId, snapshot, and window engagement mirrored through SpatialPlayShellController.setPaneEngagement. Engagement commands include pane in args so each window routes input/options to its own InteractionRepl. Derived panes keep auto-fit on first load. All @cad/js/renderer tests pass (45).
